info.title: Home Helper
info.description:
Shared household data for the Personal Home Helper phone app: money, shopping,
kitchen, chores, health logs and planning, all scoped to a household.

**Auth:** `POST /login` returns a Sanctum token; send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

**Errors** always look like `{"message", "code", "errors"?, "request_id"}`; branch on `code`.

**Lists** take `page`, `per_page` (1–100, default 25), `sort` (`column` or `-column`),
`updated_since`, and `from`/`to` on dated modules.

**Rate limits:** 120 requests/min per user, login 6/min per account, sync 60/min, invites 20/hour.

Full guide: docs/api.md in the repository.
